title: Heart of Psychedelic Visions
description: A large white heart with a spiked, dripping outline dominates the composition against a dark red background with purple and red geometric shapes. Inside the heart, on a purple floral ground, a backpacking figure with a walking stick stands on the left looking toward a three-eyed, multi-faced creature with a third eye emitting smoke above a round vessel containing a red orb on the right.
prompt: A surreal black and white line art scene contained within a large white heart with sharp spiked edges and dripping paint, set against a dark red background with purple and red geometric shapes and splatters. On the left a backpacker with a walking stick stands on purple floral ground looking toward the right. On the right a bizarre three-eyed multi-faced creature with an open mouth and a large third eye on top of its head emits smoke above a round vessel with a red orb inside. The heart has a dripping bottom edge with abstract purple shapes.
